name: Laser Slice Skyway
blurb: A skyway of light over a sleeping city: climb to the high road, corkscrew down through your own lane and launch off the sky deck for a long glide home.

name: Hologram Heights
blurb: Wind up the terraces of a tower of light around a giant spinning hologram, cross the roof and glide out over everything you just climbed.

name: Synthwave Supreme
blurb: The last race of the night: a figure of eight under a huge striped sun, with a climbing loop over your own road and a glide straight into the sunset.
